caption: The drawing depicts an octagonal serving platter with an oval central area rendered in shades of gray, giving it a metallic appearance. The platter has a broad decorative border featuring intricate patterns. At the top center of the border, there is a monogram consisting of the letters "KHC." The background of the drawing shows brown and tan watercolor washes, creating an uneven, mottled effect around the platter. In the upper left corner, there is a small inset detail of the decorative pattern on the platter’s border, and in the lower right corner, there is a technical line sketch showing the platter’s outline and proportions. The overall composition centers the platter, with the decorative and technical elements positioned in the corners.
title: Silver Platter
